description: Creates a Stripe Customer Session for client-side access to configured components, such as the Payment Element or customer sheet.

components.description: Configuration for each component. At least 1 component must be enabled.

buy_button.description: Configuration for the buy button component.

enabled.description: Whether the buy button component is enabled.
enabled.title: Enabled

buy_button.title: BuyButtonComponent

customer_sheet.description: Configuration for the customer sheet component.

payment_method_allow_redisplay_filters.description: Filter payment methods by allow_redisplay values. Options: 'always', 'limited', 'unspecified'. Default: ['always'].

customer_sheet.title: CustomerSheetComponent

mobile_payment_element.description: Configuration for the mobile payment element component.

enabled.description: Whether the mobile payment element is enabled.
enabled.title: Enabled

features.description: Configuration for mobile payment element features.

payment_method_allow_redisplay_filters.description: Filter payment methods by allow_redisplay values.

payment_method_save_allow_redisplay_over.title: Payment Method Save Allow Redisplay Override

features.title: MobilePaymentElementFeatures

mobile_payment_element.title: MobilePaymentElementComponent

payment_element.description: Configuration for the payment element component.

enabled.description: Whether the payment element is enabled.

name: create_customer_session

client_secret.description: A single-use secret credential string used for client-side API access. This provides temporary access to the customer session.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

components.description: Echo of the enabled components configuration from the request.

customer.description: The ID of the customer associated with this session.

livemode.title: Livemode
